committee.sub: Morning brief · Monday 9 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend last7 was A$145.21 on 19 clicks (cpc A$7.64) with zero conversions, and the landing-page test credit is now at A$0 after A$672.07 raw spend since 6 Oct, so the pause-or-continue decision point is live.

adsChanges shows no external edits in the last 24h or 7d, so recent test numbers are not contaminated by outside changes; impression share 30d sits at 10% with rank lost at 77.4% against budget lost of 14.7%, meaning ad rank, not budget, is the bigger constraint, but budget stays fixed while the test runs.

Raw landing-page events since start show ask_cta_click at 17 and quick_question_click at 3 against review_cta_click at 0; totalPaidClicks is now 96, well past the click-25 freeze point, so headline, offer and CTAs stay locked unless broken.

generate_lead fired twice in the last7 (vs 0 prior7) against the 96 raw paid clicks; these are unverified enquiry candidates only, Chris needs to check the Formspree/Cal.com source on each and grade them against the qualified rule before counting them as demand.

actions.text: landingPageTest.totalPaidClicks has reached 96, past the 75-click checkpoint. Chris should check the test log now; if relevant clicks are 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries, the red flag is live.
Clicks are well past 25, so the page headline, offer and CTAs stay frozen unless something is broken.

creditRemainingExGst has fallen to A$0, below the A$30 threshold. Apply the standing rule: pause paid search unless cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked (review_cta_click is still 0, so no booking yet).
generate_lead sits at 2 since the test started. Check the Formspree and Cal.com emails for source details on each and log them as graded or not yet qualified in the test log.
Standing item: logo and image assets for the serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake) are still outstanding.
Standing item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success. These need updating to current site stats.
